as_told.title: Mario runs out of Close Encounters screening
as_told.place_text: Theater on Main Street, Rapid City, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Later in the year, when Close Encounters [of the Third Kind] came out, the mailbox scene freaked me out so badly that I had to get up and walk out of the theatre.

plain: A former nuclear missile guard named Mario Woods says that in 1977, watching the film Close Encounters of the Third Kind in a theatre on Main Street in Rapid City, South Dakota, he had to get up and run out, then sat on the curb. He says what he saw on screen felt like 'a direct replay of what I just went through', meaning his own encounter at the missile site. He tells it twice on the show, the second time more briefly, and a 2017 article by the researcher Robert Hastings quotes him saying the mailbox scene 'freaked me out so badly that I had to get up and walk out of the theatre.'
